summary: Protect live build snapshots with per-snapshot flocks across callers using different build roots.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of application data.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only snapshot cleanup safety. Each snapshot owns a lock in the shared snapshot namespace; build-root locks no longer authorize removal of other runs' snapshots.

downtime.detail: No running service is activated by this change.

recovery.detail: Application data is unchanged. Stale snapshots are reclaimed only when their individual lock can be acquired without blocking.
